title: Obesity and depression – development, acceptance, effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of a self-help strengthening online coach
summary:
Individuals with chronic somatic conditions such as obesity often experience psychological distress. Digital interventions for improving mental health can meaningfully complement traditional treatment approaches. The acceptance of digital interventions can be improved when they also address the specific challenges associated with the somatic condition. So far, there are no digital interventions focusing specifically on improving the mental health of people with obesity. Within the @ktivPLUS study, an online intervention was therefore developed aiming to improve the mental health of individuals with obesity. In the study, this intervention is compared with the use of an informational website that also addresses the mental health of people with obesity (online bibliotherapy). Study participants will be randomly assigned to one of the two study conditions. The study aims to examine the efficacy, acceptability, and effectiveness of the online intervention compared to the online bibliotherapy. This will be assessed using written questionnaires – administered before using the online intervention or online bibliotherapy and again four months later. The study investigates whether mental well-being improves by using the intervention. The results of the study are intended to contribute to improved care for individuals with psychological impairments.

Update November 24, 2026: To assess long-term outcomes, a Post-Trial Follow-Up (PTFU) will be conducted approximately 12 months after the baseline assessment.

interventions.name: Intervention group: Access to an unguided online intervention for improving mental health in people with obesity (14 modules, each lasting 20–40 minutes; recommended usage: 1 module per week; flexible use regarding order and timing)
Active control group: Access to an online bibliotherapy (informational website) on mental health and obesity (flexible use regarding order and timing)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
BMI >= 30,
PHQ-8 >= 5,
internet access,
sufficient German language skills,
informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
current suicidal tendencies (BDI-II suicide item > 1), 
no contact person in crisis situations (e.g. GP),
current psychotherapy,
unstable psychopharmacological medication in the last 6 weeks
